metadata.name: profile-image-cropper
metadata.description: A drag-to-reposition, wheel/slider-to-zoom circular image cropper for producing a square profile picture from an uploaded photo.
features: Drag the image to reposition it within a fixed circular frame
Zoom via mouse wheel or an external range input bound the same way as the image
Confirm button exports a cropped square image as a base64 JPEG data URL
Exposes the result as a component variable so other elements/workflows can read it

properties.name: imageUrl
properties.description: The raw uploaded image (data URL or URL) to crop.

properties.name: confirmButtonLabel
properties.description: Text shown on the confirm-crop button.

events.name: cropped
events.description: Fires when the user clicks the confirm button. Payload value is the cropped image as a base64 JPEG data URL.

actions.label: Reset crop
actions.description: Resets zoom and position back to the initial centered view.

variables.name: croppedImage
variables.description: The most recent cropped image as a base64 JPEG data URL. Updated whenever the user confirms a crop.

specifications: Root element is fluid width; the crop stage itself is a fixed 320x320 circle regardless of container size.
Nothing happens until `imageUrl` is set — shows a placeholder text otherwise.
The image always starts scaled to cover the circular frame and centered; zoom range is 1x (cover) to 4x.
Dragging and zooming only update local view state — nothing is written back until the confirm button is clicked.
Designed for profile/avatar photos; output is always a square JPEG regardless of the source image's aspect ratio.

examples.description: Basic usage bound to an uploaded raw image variable
